value.rationale: The exceptional twelve-point Witt matroid is a canonical rank-six design object with a genuinely sporadic full symmetry group. The multiplicity-free top homology representation, explicit integral kernel and three irreducible constituent degrees 55+99+176 supply structural equivariant information unavailable from the classical shellability theorem, plain Euler count, or published character table in isolation. Motivated by classifying M12 topology rather than arbitrary numerical slicing. Fløystad’s general Steiner-dual work is credited for the same-complex non-equivariant framework.
